translations.translatedText: # Radio | Clear News | Saturday 20.5.2023
Fighter jet aid for Ukraine. G7 countries. Inclusion. Strike threat for day-care centres and care homes. Weather forecast.
## Fighter jet aid for Ukraine

![Kristi Raik, deputy director of the International Centre for Defence and Security ICDS in Estonia.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_7977,h_4487,x_0,y_234/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-1116662646879f052d8d/1684568603)
Open image viewer
Deputy director of the International Centre for Defence and Security in Estonia, Kristi Raik. Photo: Henrietta Hassinen / Yle

An expert says that the US decision to support fighter jet aid for Ukraine is important. The US supports European countries so that they can give fighter jets to Ukraine. Britain, Denmark, the Netherlands and Belgium have promised that they will give Ukraine F-16 fighter jets and training for using the fighter jets.
Deputy director of the ICDS **Kristi Raik** says that it is good that Ukraine gets fighter jets from European countries. Ukraine needs new fighter jets, because Ukraine's own fighter jets are old.
Raik says that Ukraine can use the F-16 fighter jets properly only after the summer. The F-16 fighter jets were made by an American company.
## G7 countries, China, Russia

![G7 leaders stand in front of the memorial to the atomic bomb attack in Hiroshima.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_8270,h_4651,x_4,y_337/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-11158886466f6788be6f/1684469473)
Open image viewer
Leaders of the G7 countries in Hiroshima, Japan. Photo: EPA-EFE / Franck Robichon
The group of leading industrial countries, the G7 countries, say that China must pressure Russia. The G7 countries want Russia to end its attack on Ukraine and to withdraw its troops from Ukraine.
The G7 countries want China to pressure Russia, because China and Russia keep in close contact. The leaders of the G7 countries have gathered for a meeting in Japan.
Ukrainian President **Volodymyr Zelenskyi** has also arrived at the G7 countries' meeting in Japan.
## Inclusion in working life

![A sign with a picture of a wheelchair and the text ingång (entrance).](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5184,h_2916,x_0,y_146/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-106016963c679240604b/1673951734)
Open image viewer
Inclusion means that everyone can take part on an equal basis. Photo: Helena von Alfthan / Yle

Finland wants to improve inclusion in working life. Inclusion in working life means that all people can take part in working life on an equal basis. For example, company premises are built to be accessible, and people of many kinds are hired.
Companies' interest in inclusion has grown. 65 percent of Finnish companies say that inclusiveness is important to the company's operations.
Researcher **Saara Leppänen** says that inclusiveness is, however, realised quite rarely in companies.
## Strike threat in the social and health sector

![An elderly person has coffee at Vaarinsaari care home in Mikkeli.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5472,h_3078,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-876086618512b71a792/1636111838)
Open image viewer
In some care homes and day-care centres a strike may begin next Tuesday. Photo: Niko Mannonen / Yle
The social and health sector is preparing for a strike. Private social service providers are trying to ensure client safety, also during a possible strike.
If a strike begins, temporary staff will come to day-care centres and care homes, for example. Also supervisors, that is, bosses, will take part in many tasks then.

The strike begins next Tuesday, if no solution is found to the pay dispute before then. The strike affects some private day-care centres and care homes for the elderly. The strike does not concern the whole social and health sector.
## The weather
![Sunday's weather map.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_1919,h_1080,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-11169056468d5c3dc235/1684592097)
Open image viewer
On Sunday it is sunny and warm.
The weather is summery and warm. On Sunday it is sunny across a wide area. The temperature is between 17 and 24 degrees, and in North Lapland it is cooler in places.
